statement: There is a limiting impact coordinate S(T, Y ) with the following properties. (i) For every fixed aperture and every bounded complex parameter range, it is jointly holomorphic sufficiently deep in the corresponding cone and is the locally uniform limit of (9.23). There, S(T, Y ) − Y = O |T|2 D1−2α , D = −ℑY −→ ∞. (9.24) (ii) Put J = SY , z = TF(S)J 2 , g(z) = 3(sin z − z cos z) z3 , g(0) = 1. (9.25) The limiting equation is J3 g(z) = 1. (9.26) (iii) For every fixed ε > 0, set r = 1/(λ + ε). There are constants Cε, t0 > 0 such that, for every real |T| < t0, the model is holomorphic in Y and maps {Y : ℑY < −Cε|T|r } −→ H−. (9.27) It satisfies S(0, Y ) = Y , obeys (9.26) throughout this domain, and depends continuously on real T, locally uniformly on strict common interiors. (iv) At every strict interior point of (9.27) with T real, these functions have a joint holomorphic germ in (T, Y ). The germs agree when continued along vertical Y -paths from the deep model.
